title: Machinal
summary: Inspired by the real-life case of convicted and executed murderer, Ruth Snyder, the play had its Broadway premiere in 1928 and is widely considered to be one of the great plays of the 20th century.
about: This production, set in modern day Tennessee against the backdrop of today’s rise of the ‘tradwife’, asks if, one hundred years later, anything has really changed at all?
Machinal is performed by graduating acting students and supported by technical students of Bristol School of Acting.
responsibilities: Oversaw the tracking and sourcing of props
Assured a smooth rehearsal and production
Assisted in the get-in and strike
Ran fast paced stage cues during show runs

sections.title: Challenges
sections.text: My first professional production as an ASM brought challenges where I had to learn new methods and managerial skills. Along with a sizable prop count and tracking list, I was glad to have the support and teaching from Stage Managers - Cheryl Curley and Hannah Clare.
